summary_en: FY3/27 interim dividend raised from ¥35/share to ¥45/share (¥35 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative to mark 30 years since listing); full-year dividend ¥80/share (interim ¥45 + year-end ¥35). Commemorative dividend recognizes shareholder support over three decades.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Cresco announced on 31 July 2026 a revision to its FY3/27 dividend forecast. The company is marking its 30th anniversary since listing on the over-the-counter market. The interim dividend (mid-period, second quarter-end) has been raised from the previously forecast ¥35/share to ¥45/share, comprising ¥35 in ordinary dividend and ¥10 in commemorative dividend. The year-end dividend remains ¥35/share, bringing the full-year dividend to ¥80/share versus the prior forecast of ¥70/share. The commemorative dividend is intended as an expression of gratitude to shareholders for their long-standing support. The company frames this distribution within its stated capital allocation policy: maintaining shareholder returns as a core management priority, ensuring balance-sheet strength and stable long-term earnings, and executing share buybacks when warranted. Management notes that on 8 May 2026 it had announced a separate share buyback programme of up to 1 million shares or ¥2 billion, reflecting the view that intrinsic value was not fully reflected in then-prevailing share prices; the dividend revision is aligned with that capital-return commitment.
